banner.title: cleanuparr
banner.tagline: Strikes stalled and failed queue items in the *arr apps, then removes them so each app searches again.

steps.title: Scan
steps.text: Cleanuparr reads the Sonarr, Radarr and Lidarr queues through their APIs. Its instances and rules are set in its own UI.
steps.scene: a queue of download tiles on a conveyor

steps.title: Strike
steps.text: A stalled, failed-import or metadata-stuck item collects a strike on each pass. The strike limit is set in the app, not in Git.
steps.scene: a stopwatch over a stalled tile

steps.title: Remove
steps.text: At the limit it removes the item from the download client and blocklists the release.
steps.scene: a broken tile dropping into a bin

steps.title: Search
steps.text: The *arr app sees the release is gone and searches for another one. Its config is on a 1Gi ceph-block claim, backed up by kopiur.
steps.scene: a magnifier sweeping a field of release tiles

art.about: a queue janitor that strikes stalled downloads and removes them so the *arr apps search again
art.title: How Cleanuparr clears stuck downloads
